{{Vanilla|Ancient City}}
An '''ancient city''' generates as in vanilla. [[Matcha Flavoured]] changes its chest loot, adding [[Native Silver|silver]], [[Topaz]], [[divine fragment]]s, [[crystal heart]]s and diamond equipment. The [[Archaeologist]] sells Ancient City Maps at level 4.
